ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — MayRequire Gate
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: The toggled dependency for the MayRequire-flip live test (P4). Its mere PRESENCE satisfies the MayRequire="joof.testharness.gate" gates in TestMod_MayRequire. The harness loads it for Run A and removes it before Run B, so the gated content flips inclusion between runs while its owning mod (TestMod_MayRequire) never changes. Carries one trivial ThingDef so that removing the mod changes the asset set and forces Gagarin's cache miss (an empty mod would not). No game content — dev/QA use only.
